arguments.subject: Detailed WiFi diagnostic steps for your replacement router
arguments.body:
Hi Brian,

Here are the detailed diagnostics to run when your replacement router (SKU-1026) arrives:

1. SPEED TESTS: Run 3-4 tests daily (morning, afternoon, evening) for a full week at fast.com. If your internet plan is 200Mbps+, expect at least 100Mbps in your back bedroom. Consistent speed is key.

2. SIGNAL CHECK: Use your phone's WiFi settings to check signal strength (bars) in your office. Should show at least 2-3 bars consistently.

3. PATTERN TRACKING: Note if drops happen during specific activities (microwave use, etc.) or times of day.

4. NODE POSITION: Place one mesh node closer to your home office if possible - even moving it 10-15 feet can help.

If speeds drop below 50Mbps consistently or you see frequent disconnects, email me immediately. We'll explore other solutions under warranty at no cost to you.

Your replacement order: ORD-35632
Tracking will be sent separately.

TechMart Support

arguments.subject: Detailed WiFi diagnostic steps for your replacement router
arguments.body:
Hi Brian,

Here are the detailed diagnostics to run when your replacement router (SKU-1026) arrives:

1. SPEED TESTS: Run 3-4 tests daily (morning, afternoon, evening) for a full week at fast.com. If your internet plan is 200Mbps+, expect at least 100Mbps in your back bedroom. Consistent speed is key.

2. SIGNAL CHECK: Use your phone's WiFi settings to check signal strength (bars) in your office. Should show at least 2-3 bars consistently.

3. PATTERN TRACKING: Note if drops happen during specific activities (microwave use, etc.) or times of day.

4. NODE POSITION: Place one mesh node closer to your home office if possible - even moving it 10-15 feet can help.

If speeds drop below 50Mbps consistently or you see frequent disconnects, email me immediately. We'll explore other solutions under warranty at no cost to you.

Your replacement order: ORD-35632
Tracking will be sent separately.

TechMart Support

arguments.subject: Step-by-step guide for testing your WiFi replacement
arguments.body:
Hi Brian,

Here's your detailed testing guide:

1. TEST ON MULTIPLE DEVICES:
   - Run speed tests on both laptop AND tablet
   - Use fast.com 3x daily (morning, afternoon, evening)
   - Record results in a simple spreadsheet

2. NODE MOVEMENT:
   - Moving a node is quick: press sync button, then use app to "Add Node"
   - Takes 5 minutes vs. hours for initial setup
   - Aim for 15-20 feet between nodes

3. WHAT TO LOOK FOR:
   - Consistent speeds above 50Mbps for video calls
   - Drops happening <10% of tests
   - Note patterns (time of day, specific activities)

4. CERTAINTY CHECK:
   - Test for 7 full days
   - Compare to your previous experience
   - If issues persist, we'll swap for a different model under warranty

If speed drops below 50Mbps more than 10% of the time, that's a problem we'll address.

Your replacement (SKU-1026) ships today. If this one doesn't work consistently, we'll try a WiFi 6E model at no extra cost.

Best,
TechMart Support
